2502 Iosias {ee-o-see'-as}

源自希伯來文 SNH02977; 陽性專有名詞

AV - Josias 2; 2

約西亞= "耶和華所醫治的"
1) 猶大王, 在猶太人中恢復真神的敬拜, 統治31年, 約主前611年, 死於戰場 (#太 1:10-11|)
record.edic_text:
2502 Iosias {ee-o-see'-as}

of Hebrew origin 02977;; n pr m

AV - Josias 2; 2

Josiah = "whom Jehovah heals"
1) king of Judah, who restored among the Jews the worship of the true
   God, and after a reign of thirty one years was slain in battle
   about 611 BC
